newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-KOHLER VOTED GERMAN FOOTBALLER OF THE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KOHLER VOTED GERMAN FOOTBALLER OF THE YEAR.

text.p: Borussia Dortmund defender Juergen Kohler has been voted Germany's 1997 player of the year by a panel of sports journalists.

The 31-year-old man-marker, who was instrumental in Dortmund's triumphant European Cup campaign, won the vote ahead of Bochum midfielder Dariusz Wosz and third-placed Olaf Thon, the libero with UEFA Cup winners Schalke.
Sports magazine Kicker carried out the poll of more than 1,000 sports journalists for the annual award. Kohler's Dortmund team mate Matthias Sammer won the title in 1995 and 1996 .
